key.name: ui-font
key.description: Which font the interface is drawn with. 'system' leaves the host's own setting alone — on Windows that is Segoe UI 9pt, which is smaller than the 11pt GNOME's stylesheets are drawn against. 'size' keeps the host's typeface and raises only the size, never lowering it. 'adwaita' uses the GNOME typeface the runtime bundles, and is only offered where that typeface actually reached the font map. On Linux the host font is already GNOME's, so all three agree.

key.name: interface-scale
key.description: How large the whole interface is drawn on the phone ports, as one factor over every length: 'auto' derives it from the screen (its shortest edge over the 360 logical pixels the Adwaita stylesheet is authored for, held to 1.0–1.5), a number sets it by hand. Separate from the system font size, which the platform still applies on top. Ignored where the interface is drawn by GTK itself.

key.name: primary-color
key.description: Selected primary color key. Allowed values: 'none' (never chosen, the app default tint applies), 'off' for no tint, or one of 'blue','teal','green','yellow','orange','red','pink','purple','slate'.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Selected accent color key. Allowed values: 'system' to follow the system accent, or one of 'blue','teal','green','yellow','orange','red','pink','purple','slate'.

key.name: font-name
key.description: Font used in the code editor

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Whether to show line numbers in the editor

key.name: auto-indent
key.description: Whether to enable auto indentation in the editor

key.name: debugger-enabled
key.description: Whether the debugger watches the simulator. Watching costs a callback per executed instruction, which is noticeable on slow devices, so it starts off and the switch on the debugger page turns it on. A learner's own choice is stored here and wins over this default.

key.name: support-prompt-years
key.summary: Years the support prompt was shown
key.description: The calendar years in which the note inviting learners to support the project was already shown. It appears at most once per year, and the year is recorded when the note appears.
